from collections import deque
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter, deque
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=set(); boxes=[]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        color=grid[r][c]
        if color==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
        q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
        while q:
          y,x=q.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
          for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
            if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx]==color:
              seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
        if len(cells)>=3:
          rs=[a for a,b in cells]; cs=[b for a,b in cells]
          boxes.append((color,min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)))
    out=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for color,r1,r2,c1,c2 in boxes:
      for r in range(r1,r2+1):
       for c in range(c1,c2+1): out[r][c]=color
    return out
'''
